input: What time is check-in?
rows.reply: Check-in is from 2:00 PM (14:00) onwards. Early check-in from 10:00 AM may be available for INR 1,500, subject to availability — you can request it at the front desk or by email, but it can't be guaranteed in advance. Check-out is by 11:00 AM.

input: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
rows.reply: Yes, The Palm Grove Resort has an outdoor lagoon swimming pool open daily from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM, with a separate shallow children's pool. Pool towels are provided at the pool deck, a lifeguard is on duty from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and swimwear is required.

input: What is the cancellation policy?
rows.reply: Standard (flexible) rates can be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before your check-in date. Cancellations within 48 hours of check-in, and no-shows, are charged the first night's room rate. Non-refundable promotional rates cannot be cancelled, changed, or refunded. Refunds for eligible cancellations are processed to the original payment method within 7 working days.

input: Which room is suitable for three guests?
rows.reply:
It depends on whether the three guests are all adults or include children:

• Deluxe Pool View Room — sleeps up to 3 guests (max 3 adults, max 2 children). Rates from INR 7,800/night before taxes, breakfast included.
• Family Suite — sleeps up to 5 guests (max 4 adults, max 2 children). Rates from INR 12,500/night before taxes, breakfast included.
• Ocean Villa — sleeps up to 4 guests, but only max 2 adults (max 2 children). Rates from INR 21,000/night before taxes, breakfast included.

If all three are adults, the Deluxe Pool View Room or the Family Suite would work. If you have two adults and one child, the Ocean Villa is also an option.

input: Is breakfast included?
rows.reply: Breakfast is included in the rate for the Deluxe Pool View Room, Family Suite, and Ocean Villa. For the Garden Standard Room, breakfast is not included, but it can be added for INR 650 per adult per day (children under 6 eat free). Breakfast is served at the Palm Leaf restaurant from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.

input: Where can I charge my EV in your parking?
rows.reply: Unfortunately, The Palm Grove Resort does not have any EV charging points on the property. Free on-site parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis, but we're unable to offer EV charging. You may want to check nearby public charging stations in the Candolim area, or our front desk can help point you in the right direction.

input: Since pets are allowed, can I bring my cat along?
rows.reply: I appreciate your interest in staying with us! However, I should clarify that pets are actually not allowed on the property — the only exception is registered service animals. So unfortunately, you wouldn't be able to bring your cat along. If you have any other questions or need help with anything else, I'm happy to assist!
